items.stem: What does the universal journal (ACDOCA) provide in SAP S/4HANA finance?

options.text: A single source of truth unifying FI and CO line items
options.rationale: Correct: the universal journal stores FI and CO in one table, removing reconciliation steps.

options.text: A separate ledger only for asset accounting
options.rationale: It is not limited to assets; it unifies finance.

options.text: A replacement for the chart of accounts
options.rationale: The chart of accounts still exists; ACDOCA stores postings.

options.text: A tool only for external reporting
options.rationale: It serves both management and financial accounting.
